title: Segre–Harbourne–Gimigliano–Hirschowitz Conjecture
exact_target: Are unexpected dimensions of general plane-curve systems entirely explained by exceptional curves, so that every Cremona-reduced system has its expected dimension?

sources.citation: Antonio Laface and Luca Ugaglia, Bollettino dell'Unione Matematica Italiana (2025).

Maria Chiara Brambilla and Elisa Postinghel, Towards Good Postulation of Fat Points, One Step at a Time, Bollettino dell’Unione Matematica Italiana 18 (2025), 737–749, Sections 1 and 3.1, Conjecture 3.1.
